product_metadata.title: DampRid Moisture Absorber with Activated Charcoal for Boats & RVs, 18 oz.Fragrance Free
features: DISPOSABLE MOISTURE ABSORBER with Activated Charcoal traps excess moisture, creating fresher, cleaner air in stored boats & RVs.
ABSORBS AND REMOVES ODOR: Activated charcoal doesn't just cover up musty odors, it absorbs and removes odors from the toughest sources.
18-OUNCE CONTAINER: This 18-ounce container absorbs and removes odors from areas of approximately 300 square feet – perfect for stored boats and RVs that are left sitting for months at a time.
LASTS UP TO 60 DAYS: Each DampRid Disposable Moisture Absorber provides up to 60 days of moisture absorbing action depending on temperature and humidity.
EASY TO USE: To activate, simply remove the lid and peel off the foil. Discard the container once the crystals have fully dissolved.
description: DampRid Disposable Moisture Absorber with Activated Charcoal is the moisture absorber odor eliminator that will make the air cleaner in small spaces that go months without use. This unique moisture absorber with the activated charcoal doesn't just cover up musty odors, it absorbs and removes odors from the toughest sources. No more stale, stagnant, musty smells! Designed for use in stored, sitting boats and RVs, where stagnant air and excess humidity are often a problem. To use, simply remove the lid, peel off the foil and place where desired. Discard the canister once the crystals have fully dissolved. Keep out of reach of children. Read and follow all label directions.
